purpose: Monetization transforms for the vol_trend_10v50 signal investigated in phases 1-7, 11-13 of VOL_TREND_SIGNAL_TO_ALPHA. Pre-registered BEFORE holdout_2 data acquisition and BEFORE any transform evaluation.

costs.rebalance: daily at close, equal weight per leg
costs.cost_floor_note: 25 bps/side covers brokerage + realistic impact; 15 bps/side equals the frozen pipeline base cost and is reported as a sensitivity only

evaluation_stages.selection_gate: DEVELOPMENT VALIDATION split: transform has net_25bps LS mean > 0 AND 95% block-bootstrap (block=63, 1000 sims) CI lower > 0; p = fraction of bootstrap sims <= 0; then BH-FDR at q <= 0.10 across the five transforms
evaluation_stages.confirmation: each SELECTED transform evaluated EXACTLY ONCE on holdout_2 FINAL-OOS; considered monetizable only if net_25bps mean > 0 AND CI lower > 0 on that single run
evaluation_stages.no_tuning: no re-specification, threshold search, or resampling after results are observed; if no transform passes the gate, honourably record not-monetizable

transforms.description: Long top-decile, short bottom-decile of raw vol_trend_10v50 cross-sectional rank
Long top-quintile, short bottom-quintile of raw vol_trend_10v50 cross-sectional rank
Long/short deciles of vol_trend_10v50 scaled by per-symbol trailing 252d std of the feature (volume-scale neutralised)
Long/short deciles of within-date, within-sector percentile rank (sector-balanced)
Long/short deciles of per-date cross-sectional rank-OLS residual of the feature on rank(beta), rank(vol), rank(mom), rank(trend), rank(size), rank(liquidity)

metrics_per_run: net LS at 25 bps and 15 bps per side
annualised Sharpe and Sortino, max drawdown
